serviceContent.title: Technical FAQ

tdsFAQ.question: Do you replace Tally?
tdsFAQ.answer: No. We are the Operational Layer. Tally remains your financial Golden Record via our plug-and-play concurrent sync.

tdsFAQ.question: Can you handle multi-branch?
tdsFAQ.answer: Yes. We support Multi-Company Concurrent Sync and Multiple outlet/warehouse management.

tdsFAQ.question: What about security?
tdsFAQ.answer: We use 8 Levels of Enterprise Grade Security from perimeter to core.
